apps.description: Private, read-only Uptime Kuma client for Android: monitor your self-hosted servers' status, uptime, response times & certificates on the go. FOSS, GPLv3, Material You, no ads or tracking.
apps.releaseNotes:
### Changed

- **The certificate warning follows your server's 'TLS Certificate Expiry' setting.** Before, a certificate was flagged as expiring under 21 days, whatever the server said. With short-lived certificates (about 7 days), every line on the Certificates tab stayed colored and the dashboard count didn't go down to zero.
- Now the app uses the biggest number in that list on your Uptime Kuma server. That's for the color on the Certificates tab, the count on the dashboard and the expiry notification. The app reads it when it connects, so a change shows after the next reconnect. An empty list turns the warning off. Servers without that setting keep 21 days. With several servers aggregated, each certificate uses its own server's setting.

apps.description: TubeArchivist Client for Android and Linux
apps.releaseNotes:
> This is an early release.
> There may be bugs.

**Features:**
- Fast-forward on long press, contributed by @it-lacks
- Added page-style pagination as the new default

**Improvements:**
- Added a setting to change the pagination style
- Added direct page navigation
- Improved video seeking stability

**Bug Fixes:**
- Fixed forced queue refreshes on the “Actions” page
- Fixed a null error when search results contain a local playlist

**Other:**
- Made several previously untranslatable strings translatable
- Enabled legacy packaging to reduce APK size
- Updated dependencies
- Updated the Kotlin version
- Updated translations

**Thanks to:**
- Everyone who submitted issues
- @BlackZ — Polish translations
- @gallegonovato — Spanish translations
- @Vistaus — Dutch tr

en.summary: A modern, feature-rich TubeArchivist companion app

apps.description: Escapepod - Podcast Player for Android
apps.releaseNotes:
- third-party widgets can control playback again
- the media notification shows the seek buttons instead of previous and next
- fixed an update indicator that could run forever or flicker during an update
- fixed two crashes (failed OPML backup, tapping a podcast card without episodes)
- updated translations
- updated software libraries

### Versions

- `escapepod-app-release-1.6.8.apk` → regular free version of Escapepod – if you are not sure, download this one
- `escapepod-app-beta-1.6.8-non-free.apk` → non-free version that supports Google Cast
